messages:
Claire: Need a compact micro-deck + social kit for the Oct benchmark webinar. Minimalist, data-forward.
Noah: What pieces are required?
Claire: Deliverables: 3-slide micro-deck (16:9), single A4 quick-guide (print PDF), 3 carousel cards (1080x1080), IG story vertical (1080x1920), email header (600x200), and a tiny decision matrix PNG (700x500). Also one small 'spark bar' chart (latency vs cost) for the guide.
Jules: Visual treatment? photography/illustration?
Claire: All illustrated. Clean icons, muted navy + teal + sunset accent, 2 tones only. High contrast text.
Design-ops: Brand note: use brand tokens v2, keep 16px clearspace on logo, supply SVGs for icons and PNG@2x for socials. I'll attach tokens and an export checklist.
Noah: Timeline?
Claire: First roughs in 48 hours, final handoff 48 hours after copy freeze. Prioritize micro-deck slide 1 and email header.
Jules: Spark bar chart 1: show where batching flips cost/latency with a small percent label. Keep gridlines light.
Upload-bot: Template uploaded: https://figma.com/file/unique-microdeck-template
Noah: Scheduling a 20m review 10:15am PT tomorrow to look at roughs. RSVP please.
Claire: Thanks 1 - flag me if blocked on brand access or the Figma link.
